tiers.note: Double-quantization trap: 82% of fine-tuned ΔW = (α/r)BA updates are smaller than 1 INT4 bin step and get rounded away to 0 (-8.4 pt drop)!

tiers.note: Preserves ΔW in BF16 (78.4% accuracy), but requires 2x GPUs (140 GB HBM) and drops decode throughput by 2.54x (1,120 tok/s).

tiers.name: Unmerged Quantized Base (Marlin INT4 / FP8) + BF16 LoRA SGMV Side-Branch
tiers.note: Matches exact QLoRA training graph y = Dequant(W_q)x + B(Ax) in BF16 (100% survival, 78.6% accuracy) with only 6.7% SGMV overhead.

tiers.name: Merge Into BF16 Master + SFT-Calibrated Block-FP8 / AWQ + Residual Rank-16 Adapter
tiers.note: Merges ΔW into clean BF16 master, runs SFT-calibrated 1x128 FP8 / AWQ quantization, and absorbs quantization residual -> 78.5% accuracy & 2,890 tok/s!
